minutes.headline: Select Board approved a liquor license transfer and relocation to 88 Mass Ave, over one resident's objection.
minutes.summary: The board held two public hearings, approving the Liquor Mart license transfer and relocation and a pledge-of-collateral amendment for On the Rocks. It also reviewed special town meeting warrant articles and began reviewing its bylaws, voting to change "Board of Selectmen" wording to "select board". The town manager reported many unfilled vacancies and a delay in certifying property values; the board then went into executive session on clerical union bargaining.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at opening; none offered.
A resident opposed transferring the license to 88 Mass Ave, saying there is no public need there and it should be used in the downtown area; asked for due diligence.
Chair asked for public comment at close; none recorded.

what_happened.line: The Select Board unanimously approved transferring an all-alcohol retail license to Lunenburg Liquor Mart Inc. and relocating it to 88 Mass Ave, after one resident objected.
The board approved an amendment to the On the Rocks all-alcohol license for a pledge of collateral.
The board voted to replace "Board of Selectmen" and "Selectmen" with "select board" in all legal documents except the charter.
Members could not explain the wording of the Park Commission's grant article and agreed to invite the commission to a future meeting.
The town manager reported a delay in certifying property values, with preliminary third-quarter tax bills to be mailed before Dec 31.

why_it_matters: The license move puts a liquor store at 88 Mass Ave rather than downtown, which a resident said lacks a public need.
The valuation delay means the preliminary third-quarter tax bills go out later than usual, and the minutes give a due date of Feb 1.
The special town meeting articles on the Park Commission grant and the roof reserve were questioned and left unresolved, so residents may be asked to vote on them without settled explanations.
watch_next: Planning board or Mr Bernie invited to the Oct 3 meeting to explain their special town meeting articles.
Bylaw review returns Oct 10, with members to read the four bylaw chapters.
